tiles.compact: Monday-first daily values; sum so far versus typical same weekday.
Month-to-date comparison with prior month capped at its last day; 5th–95th percentile band across completed historical months.
tiles.expanded: Current/prior-month cumulative curves and historical percentile band; daily sport bars with selected-day activity inspection; active days, activity count and measured-activity average; recent twelve same-date and completed-month totals. No past-month selector.

tiles.compact: Last-28-day headline versus prior 28 days; 12-week trend with four-full-week average.
tiles.expanded: By week (last 12 weeks), By month (last 12 months), By year (all available years); stacked area by sport, four-completed-period average including offscreen history, lighter incomplete-period shading, and period totals by sport visible without a disclosure at every width. No historical-window or chart-type picker.

tiles.compact: Year-to-date headline versus same date last year; cumulative calendar-aligned curves with a min–max band across completed prior years.
tiles.expanded: Current/prior-year calendar-aligned curves and historical min–max band; paired monthly totals by sport through the reporting month; recorded-year same-date and completed totals. Current month compares through the same date, clamping leap days.

tiles.compact: Projected year-end total with a labelled current/projection/previous-year reference bar; daily rates preserve small nonzero values.
Compact 2×2 current-year records: longest distance, longest moving time, biggest climb and biggest distance week.
tiles.expanded: Top three positive distance, moving-time and climb activities and distance weeks, with competition medals for equal values and linked identities. This year / All time appear together on wide workspaces and remain visible during inspection; narrow workspaces offer a period choice. Best 30 days remains a labelled current-year secondary section.

tiles.compact: Not drawn; totals are represented by other tiles.
Inclusive rolling year with year-qualified month labels, sport or numeric colouring, complete compact legend, striped mixed-sport days and accessible day inspection.
tiles.expanded: Rolling or selected calendar year with previous/next controls, direct cell inspection with a contrasting selected-day outline and inline activities with detail links. A collapsed-cell selection expands the tile. Keyboard/VoiceOver selection remains available; no separate date picker, popup or duplicate horizontal day strip.

tiles.compact: Not drawn. Active days per week remains in Typical week; Activity calendar shows the pattern.
Moving-time shares in one stacked bar, complete wrapping sport legend and single-sport explanation.
tiles.expanded: Sport share, moving time, activity count, distance and climb in phone rows or a wide table.

tiles.compact: Hilliness: m / km, labelled monthly bars and neutral comparison against the preceding rolling year.
tiles.expanded: Larger monthly chart and five hilliest activities with at least 5 km, in wrapping phone rows linked to detail.

tiles.compact: Moving hours and active days to one decimal, plus compact distance/climb/activity means over eleven full weeks.
Not drawn separately; values appear in expanded Records.
tiles.expanded: Before Jan 30 explain no full window, without presenting partial comparison.

tiles.compact: Not drawn. Activity frequency remains in Typical week and Activity calendar.
tiles.expanded: Calculation remains fixture-backed; not an extra native display requirement.
